Unit 4

Homework 1: Answer the three questions asked in the course.

  1. Give the SELECT command for Who will go to the party held in Peking University? 
    SELECT guest.Name 
FROM guest, party, participate ON participate
    LEFT JOIN party ON participate.Party_ID = party.Party_ID
    LEFT JOIN guest ON participate.Guest_ID = guest.guest_ID
WHERE party.Place = 'Peking University';
  2. Figure out a way to obtain the column labels returned by mysql_fetch_array. 
    $row = mysql_fetch_array($result);
$keys = array_keys($row);
foreach ($keys as $key) { print key; }
  3. Difference between CGI and PHP: CGI 是通用网关接口（协议），PHP 是 Web 开发脚本语言。PHP 可以作为 CGI 应用。CGI 可以用 PHP 以外的各种语言编写。
